title: fix(core): a navigation-only action raises no success toast unless it declares successMessage (objectui#12755)
body:
Fixes #12755
Clause-②: no

## What

A navigation-only action no longer claims a success. `type: 'url'`, its `navigation` alias and `type: 'form'` only change the route, yet each raised the generic success toast ("Action completed successfully" / 「操作已成功完成」) after it navigated. On objectstack-ai/cloud#2909 that toast made a user believe an invitation had been sent.

## How

- `packages/core/src/actions/ActionRunner.ts`: `executeUrl`, `executeNavigation` and `executeForm` hand their result to a new `announceNavigation`. A successful navigation is marked `silent` (the existing flag that means "no success toast for this result") and keeps `success: true`, unless the action declares a non-empty `successMessage`. In that case the declared copy still toasts.
- No new key, option or export: the spec declares no toast key on `InlineActionSchema`, so the rule lives in the runner. `composeSuccessMessage` is unchanged (objectui#12757 is a separate card).
- Actions that write (api, script, field update, flow) keep their success toast. The error toast of a refused navigation is unchanged.

Clause-② reason: a runner stops announcing a success that did nothing. No key, prop, export or accept set changes.

## Tests

- New `ActionRunner.navigationNoToast-12755.test.ts`: a bare url action navigates silently; the navigation alias and a form action stay silent; url plus `successMessage` toasts that copy; a refused url still error-toasts; CONTROL: an api action keeps its success toast.
- Ablation, with the restore verified against the HEAD blob: an early return of the unchanged result turns the two silence tests red; ignoring `successMessage` turns the declared-copy test red.
- `useActionRunner.test.ts` pinned the result `{ success: true }` for a navigation; it now pins `{ success: true, silent: true }`. The only non-test reader of `silent` is the toast gate.
- Every test file that names ActionRunner, executeUrl, navigateTo, handlePostExecution or completedSuccessfully: 131 files, 2185 tests passed at d437c02.

## Live reading

Backend from `e2e/live/ci/start-backend.sh` (published 18.0.0-next.2 showcase) with the console dev server from this branch. On a showcase task record, 'Open Docs' (`type: 'url'`) in the overflow menu:
- with the origin/main runner: a new tab opens and the toast "Action completed successfully" shows;
- with this branch: a new tab opens and no toast shows.

Screenshots: branch `claude/issue-12755-evidence`, `evidence/12755/`.

## Acceptance notes

- The app-shell host handlers `navigate`, `navigate_create` and `navigate_edit` also only navigate and return a non-silent success. They are outside this card's file surface and were not measured live.
- The JSDoc on `ActionResult.silent` in `@object-ui/types` still describes only the hand-off case.
